description.text:
Spaceship is an Australian fintech startup with two products in market, a pension fund and managed investment app (Voyager), that has over $1B Funds under Management. Spaceship is backed by some of the world's most prestigious investors including Sequoia Capital, Horizons Ventures, NEA and Valar Ventures.

As Director of Engineering I was responsible for:
• Oversight of key business deliverables and effective communication across all stakeholders. 
• Implementing project and product management process initiatives across all teams in the business.
• People management, including hiring processes and building a team from 5 to 12.
• Establishing a DevOps team to transition Spaceship's infrastructure and CI/CD to Kubernetes and Google Cloud Platform. 
• Implementing Scrum processes and restructuring the engineering team into sub-teams.

The Monkeys, a subsidiary of Accenture, is one of Australia’s most renowned advertising agencies, recently winning ‘Agency of the Decade’ B&T award.

React / Node.js / WebGL
Boutique advertising agency with clients such as Harley Davidson, Audi, and Department of Treasury.

Recognising that millions of bland Out Of Office emails are sent out everyday to unsuspecting colleagues and friends, our latest work for Qantas sees the creation of a new Out Of Office Travelogue, which endeavours to take the once mundane experience to a whole new level with an interesting and fun way to connect via an Instagram feed.

The Qantas Out of Office Travelogue connects your email to your Instagram and updates your auto reply email with photos you select and tag with #qantasoutofoffice. When someone emails you while you’re traveling, they’ll receive an email showcasing the latest photos from your travels.

projects.title: OAK The Most Decisive Game Ever
projects.subtitle: Apr 2016 - Apr 2016

description.text:
The Monkeys have created a game to find the least hungrythirsty person in Australia for the launch of OAK's latest flavour, Strong Iced Coffee.

The game, named "The Most Decisive Game Ever", contains ten difficult levels specifically designed to weed out the hungrythirsty. To make it even harder the game can only be played once a day, at the time of day when most people are feeling sluggish - 3PM.
